common_conditions: XCAP operations referenced by TS24.481 V19.3.0
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: Document, elements and attributes share the document entity tag.

conditions: Conditional node PUT using known ETag
claims.conclusion: Server rejects with 412; invalidate cache, fetch entire document/new ETag before retry. This does not define semantic merge.
Response ETag applies to remaining document resources, not existence of deleted node.

conditions: GET with If-None-Match and cached ETag
claims.conclusion: Unchanged tag gives 304; changed tag gives 200 with content.

limitations: No cross-document transaction or automatic merge.
RFC4825 is a referenced protocol, not itself a Release19 specification.
